corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 6th-order (ሳድስ) top hook of ኅ rather than 4th-order ኃ, matching nominative Ge'ez grammar ('ብዙኅ ሰብእ' in Mark 8:1).
The first character of the second word is ሠ ('ሠኑይ መዋዕል', Mark 14:1, translated in Column 2 Line 15 as 'እስከ ሁለት ቀን'), which was misread as ክ.
